_comment: Pre-screen input: fresh macro/pre-market conditions + per-stock news, from reliable sources. NEWS GOES STALE - refresh before relying on it. To refresh: web-search current futures/VIX/yields/oil + headlines and each stock's latest news, then rewrite this file with today's date, numbers, and source links. prescreen.py and overall.py read this; they do NOT fetch news themselves. Trigger keyword: Pre-screen.

macro.summary: Calm, mildly risk-on into the July 4th holiday weekend. The S&P 500 sits near record highs (~7,483, flat Thu Jul 2) and the Dow jumped ~1.1% (+595); the Nasdaq lagged (-0.8%) and small caps eased (-0.5%). The VIX has fallen back to ~15.8 (calm) with VVIX ~89 and the VIX curve in contango. Treasury yields are firm (10y 4.49%, 2y 4.14%) and the dollar is steady (DXY 100.9). US markets were closed Fri Jul 3; this is the weekend read for Mon Jul 6. Overnight international moves were not refreshed over the holiday.
